test_end2end_wizard_model: test the end-to-end Wizard of Wikipedia generator model using eval_model with END2END_OPTIONS
test_retrieval_wizard_model: test the Wizard of Wikipedia retrieval model using eval_model with RETRIEVAL_OPTIONS
test_knowledge_retriever_agent: test the KnowledgeRetrieverAgent by observing a topic and verifying retrieved knowledge and checked sentence
run_wizard_gpu_tests: run the GPU-dependent Wizard model tests using unittest with skipUnlessGPU decorator
eval_wizard_model_with_options: evaluate a Wizard model by passing an options dict to testing_utils.eval_model and checking metrics
